title: Civic Packet Watch
dek: A small public instrument for agendas, packets, revisions, and civic deadlines.
body:
Civic Packet Watch is a bounded PointCast pilot for reading official El Segundo agendas, packet links, cancellations, revisions, and public opportunities without turning public information into a people-search system.

The first release establishes a human-reviewed baseline: five upcoming meeting signals and one open public-art qualification. Every signal retains an official source URL, visible document-availability state, last-checked time, and baseline label. Nothing is called new or changed until a later snapshot exists.

The first useful catch is a deadline discrepancy. The City solicitation listing header displays September 16 at 5:00 PM, while the RFQ body and linked 14-page official packet state 11:00 AM PDT and warn that late qualifications will not be accepted. PointCast preserves both values, tells the reader to verify with the City, and does not silently decide which deadline controls.

A repository refresh script can ask Firecrawl v2 for structured candidate data from three official URLs. It keeps robots enforcement on, does not authenticate or bypass a rejected request, and writes to the system temp directory. Candidate data cannot automatically replace the public baseline; a human must open and verify every source before promotion.

The page has a machine-readable twin and a four-page PDF field edition. The planned OBJKT companion is 100 free Tezos editions, but the public record remains marked not minted until the owner reviews and signs the wallet transaction.

Civic Packet Watch is an independent PointCast public-information reader. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the City of El Segundo. Official city pages and documents remain authoritative.
